rationale: New Telegram giveaway bot with a Node.js HTTP backend and a Telegram Mini App frontend.

questions.question: Which language should the backend use?
Which backend framework and Telegram library should be used?

options.label: Fastify + grammY
options.description: Small, fast HTTP server with a modern Telegram Bot API library.

options.label: Express + Telegraf
options.description: Widely used Node.js HTTP server and Telegram bot library.

questions.question: What backend capabilities are required?
questions.recommendedChoice: Giveaway creation and scheduling; Participate deep links; required-channel subscription checks; participant registration; winner selection and direct messages; private /menu channel-admin discovery; Telegram webhook endpoint; Mini App API endpoints; health endpoint
questions.answer: Giveaway creation and scheduling; Participate deep links; required-channel subscription checks; participant registration; winner selection and direct messages; private /menu channel-admin discovery; Telegram webhook endpoint; Mini App API endpoints; health endpoint

questions.question: Which language should the Mini App frontend use?
Which frontend approach should the Mini App use?

options.label: Vanilla JavaScript
options.description: Minimal Telegram Mini App with no frontend framework overhead.

options.label: React
options.description: Component-based Mini App with a build step.

questions.question: What Mini App capabilities are required?
questions.recommendedChoice: Telegram WebApp initialization; giveaway list and detail views; participate action; required-channel status; creator/admin management actions; responsive mobile-first UI
questions.answer: Telegram WebApp initialization; giveaway list and detail views; participate action; required-channel status; creator/admin management actions; responsive mobile-first UI

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores should the application use?

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Durable relational storage for giveaways, channels, participants, and winners.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploads or media; not required by the current scope.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Not suitable for persistent giveaways and participant records.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?

options.label: No
options.description: Use Telegram WebApp init data and bot context instead of a separate account system.
